text:
This knotted ivy climbs and encloses in a green labyrinth the height of the poplar it harms, for all its caresses ruin it.


The eye, attending to the leafy lake, cannot decide whether it is embrace or prison; only the trunk knows whether it is favor or a jail that hides and bends it.


Ah, Lisi, whoever sees me enriched by lofty worship of your beauty and attended by such noble pains,


let him ask my passion and fortune, and learn that what he judges the glory of my madness is the prison of my senses.

translation.title: This Knotted Ivy That Climbs
